tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the Catalogue App directory of Telegram mini apps, bots and TON services by name, @username or topic. Returns name, category, one-line description, monthly users where measured, and links to the catalogue card and to the app in Telegram.

tools.name: search_channels
tools.description: Search 1.5M+ public Telegram channels, group chats and bots tracked by Catalogue App. Filter by kind and size. Returns @username, title, kind, subscriber count and links.

tools.name: search_packs
tools.description: Search the Catalogue App library of Telegram custom emoji and sticker packs by theme, title, emoji or pack name. Returns pack title, short name, add link (t.me/addemoji or t.me/addstickers) and catalogue page.

tools.name: list_bot_templates
tools.description: List Catalogue App bot templates (support, feedback, anonymous questions, shop, paid channel, captcha and more). Each one is a ready bot graph with a one-click creation link.

tools.name: create_bot
tools.description: Get a link that creates the user's own Telegram bot in one tap — no @BotFather, no token, no server. Takes a template slug (support, feedback, shop and others) or a plain-words description of the bot. The user opens the link in Telegram, confirms, and the bot is live and hosted by @catalogue_app; th

tools.name: create_pack
tools.description: Get a link to the Catalogue App pack studio in Telegram: the user's own photos, videos or GIFs become a custom emoji or sticker pack, or a pack is assembled from the library by theme. Returns a t.me link that opens the studio with the request filled in.

tools.name: telegram_bot_api_guide
tools.description: Practical, current notes on Telegram: what changed in 2025–2026, managed bots, Mini Apps, custom emoji and sticker packs, Telegram Stars payments, webhooks and limits, group and channel moderation, and secretary mode for personal chats — with links to the official docs.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "telegram_bot_api_guide" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
